text:
tanya_cs: Hey all 1 1 Quick recap from SilverLeaf's private/VPC dry-run earlier today. I pulled the post-run notes into one thread so ENG/Infra/Security can action.

ayaan_customer: Thanks Tanya. Biggest compliance hit was around KMS: our auditors won't allow automated rotations during the cutover window (they call it a 'split-key blackout').

mike_infra: Noted. We can add a split-key/no-rotation blackout to the runbook. Proposed window: 2026-05-04T22:00Z -> 2026-05-07T06:00Z (32h). Ayaan, does that align with your ops schedule?

ayaan_customer: That fits. We'll gate any key ops in our change control system for that window. Please add an explicit "ack" checkbox for the customer security rep.

mike_infra: Will do. Another KMS detail: customer wants to own the CMK (preferred). We'll need them to include the redwood-servicerole ARN in the key policy and allow kms:CreateGrant for Firehose/S3 writes.

tanya_cs: Ayaan can you drop the key ARN and the minimal policy snippet here when you have it? Security needs to review before we wire Firehose.

ayaan_customer: Yes. We'll generate a constrained key and post ARN by EOD. Policy will be minimal, will scope Principal to the Redwood role.

OpsBot: Runbook update: added KMS blackout window, awaiting CMK ARN, awaiting S3 delivery config, audit retention set to 365 days (customer), network allowlist pending.

mike_infra: Networking follow-up: we saw blocked SYNs from their egress during the test. They are SNATing via NAT gateway pairs; need public EIP list and the egress prefix advertised on the peering route. Please confirm the egress prefix (CIDR) and whether TGW or classic VPC peering is used.

ayaan_customer: Egress prefix is 100.64.12.0/22. We're using VPC Peering (no TGW). SNAT EIPs: 54.210.11.33 and 54.210.11.34.

mike_infra: Added 100.64.12.0/22 to our mgmt allowlist and pinned the two EIPs. Note: VPC peering requires routes in both route tables; we saw the peer wasn't advertising the egress prefix so traffic to our mgmt plane was dropped. Ayaan, please ensure the peer route for 100.64.12.0/22 is present in your route table.

ayaan_customer: Will check and update.

tanya_cs: Logging: Customer requirement is 365-day audit retention and daily parity checks between CloudTrail and the customer's SIEM. We suggested Firehose -> S3 (SSE-KMS with customer CMK) then their SIEM pulls from S3. Ayaan, confirm SIEM can poll S3 or if you prefer push.

ayaan_customer: SIEM team prefers push via HTTPS ingest, but can do S3 polls as fallback. If we use Firehose HTTP endpoint we need to provide the endpoint and cert details.

mike_infra: Option A (preferred for reliability): Firehose -> S3 encrypted with customer CMK, then Kinesis Data Firehose to HTTPS endpoint (signed). Option B: CloudTrail -> S3 -> Lambda -> HTTPS (more moving parts). We'll implement A once we have CMK + SIEM endpoint.

tanya_cs: Audit parity: Security asked for a daily checksum report comparing CloudTrail objects to SIEM ingests. Can Infra drop a checksum manifest to S3 path /manifests/YYYY-MM-DD.json?

mike_infra: Yes. We'll add a small job to generate the manifest with MD5 checksums and object counts, write it to the agreed S3 prefix. We'll also include a CloudTrail file index in runbook.

OpsBot: Checklist: CMK ARN pending from customer, SIEM HTTPS endpoint pending, route table advertisement for 100.64.12.0/22 pending, KMS blackout window in runbook (done), checksum manifest job (planned).

tanya_cs: Renewal watch 1 note: procurement sign-off could slip due to end-of-quarter approvals. If cutover delays >7 business days we'll flag AM to start renewal-risk outreach. For now timeline stands but this is on the radar.

ayaan_customer: Understood. We'll push the CMK ARN + SIEM endpoint by EOD and confirm route advertisement.

mike_infra: Action items: (1) Ayaan post CMK ARN + key policy (ETA EOD), (2) Ayaan confirm route advertisement and EIPs (ETA 2h), (3) Mike to deploy checksum manifest job and Firehose draft (ETA 24h), (4) Tanya to monitor renewal risk and escalate to AM if slip >7 business days.

ayaan_customer: I'll DM the EIPs and the SIEM cert details now. Thanks everyone.

tanya_cs: Thanks all 44d We'll reconvene tomorrow 09:00 PT if anything blocks earlier ping here.
